title: Handle app names with underscores correctly for reference documentation
summary: AL-Go now handles underscores in app names consistently with AlDoc by preserving underscores instead of converting them to dashes when generating reference documentation paths.
key_points: Removed underscore-to-dash conversion logic that caused mismatches with AlDoc
App names like '_Exclude_APIV1_' now preserve underscores in generated file paths
Added test coverage for underscore handling in app names
Fixes documentation generation failures due to path mismatch
quote: AL-Go replaced underscores like `Replace('_', '-')` meaning app names like `_Exclude_APIV1_` becomes `-Exclude-APIV1-`. AlDoc doesn't do this and allows underscores.
